reader.requirement: At --std 85 an IF statement whose own scope is closed by END-IF must be refused when NEXT SENTENCE is its THEN or ELSE phrase; NEXT SENTENCE in an IF with no END-IF of its own (including one nested inside an END-IF'd IF's arm whose END-IF pairs elsewhere) stays legal and transfers to the next sentence.

edition-consulted.switches: COBOL7486 is raised only when Year < 2002 and the IF has END_IF and a statement of either arm is a nextSentenceStatement
archaic warning COBOL0903 at 2023 only (construct next-sentence-archaic-2023)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 NEXT SENTENCE with END-IF on the same IF is an error (COBOL7486); at 2023 the same source draws only the archaic warning COBOL0903, the later editions printing no such rule
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers the THEN and ELSE arms with END-IF and the legal form without; not THEN keyword, NEXT SENTENCE in an inner END-IF'd IF, an inner IF whose END-IF pairs with it under an outer NEXT SENTENCE IF, or the run-time transfer

probes.printed: 85: COBOL7486 at each of THEN NEXT SENTENCE END-IF, NEXT SENTENCE ELSE ... END-IF, ... ELSE NEXT SENTENCE END-IF, inner IF B NEXT SENTENCE END-IF, and DISPLAY + NEXT SENTENCE END-IF (that last also COBOL2269); 2023: only COBOL0903 warnings (and COBOL2269 for the mixed arm)
probes.expected: refused at 85 per SR3 for every IF that specifies END-IF and NEXT SENTENCE

probes.printed: 85 and 2023 EXIT 0: N1 N2 INNER AFTER-INNER E1 N3 (SKIPPED-1, SKIPPED-2 not shown; nested IF ... END-IF in the ELSE of a NEXT SENTENCE IF accepted)
probes.expected: accepted: no IF here specifies both END-IF and NEXT SENTENCE; NEXT SENTENCE transfers past the sentence

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.16.3 SR3  (6.16.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3

reader.notes: The grammar admits END-IF beside NEXT SENTENCE at every edition and the 85-only arm of VisitIfStatement refuses it, asking only the IF's own two statement blocks so a nested IF's phrase is judged by that IF. Probes of both arms, nesting and the legal transfer behave as the 1985 text requires.

refuter.evidence: Probe src/r4-double.cob: IF A = 1 NEXT SENTENCE ELSE IF B = 1 DISPLAY "X" END-IF END-IF -> COBOL7486 at the outer IF at 85 (the second END-IF closes the NEXT SENTENCE IF). Probe src/r4-search.cob: a SEARCH ... WHEN ... NEXT SENTENCE inside IF ... END-IF (the NEXT SENTENCE phrase is SEARCH's, not the IF's) is accepted at 85 and transfers past the sentence (prints only AFTER). With the reader's probes (both arms, nesting both ways, the legal transfer) the arm of VisitIfStatement matches SR3 at this edition. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.16.3 SR3  (6.16.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3'.
